brief: Read the raw aliased key byte after a signed range check.
decl: std::uint32_t input_key_raw(std::span<const std::byte, 128> keys, std::uint32_t code);

bookkeeping.scope: Complete original body; no substituted dependencies.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Every 32-bit code with a read-only 128-byte key image; signed codes >=256 return zero, all others use code & 127. Full zero-extended byte returned in EAX.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 2396 complete original-body cases exact on MSVC and Zig/Clang, with no input substitutions. Six connected query/release traces also match. See docs/recovery/input-key-state.md.
unresolved: Original key-down producers, window dispatch, hardware polling and complete camera-handler integration.
